newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures mixed in post-PPI trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures mixed in post-PPI trading.

text.p: U.S. debt futures were mixed in early trading, with December Treasury bond futures near steady after gyrating early on price data.

Dec slipped to 114-20/32 after October producer prices were reported up 0.4 percent overall and down 0.3 percent excluding food and energy. Wall Street had been expecting prices to rise 0.2 percent overall and 0.1 percent in the core rate.
December slipped briefly on the stronger-than-expected overall figure, then recovered when the focus switched to the tame core rate, traders said.

December poked to a fresh session and nine-month high at 115-2/32 briefly but soon erased some of those gains, as well. Traders said the market was jittery after its recent string of eight-month highs and may be subject to a bit of profit-taking.
Traders pegged support at 114-18/32 and 114-13/32. More support lurks at 114-2/32 and 113-20/32, they said.
Reaction to the early data was subdued in the short-end, with March Eurodollars within a tight four-basis-point range.
Traders pegged support in March at 94.42-94.43 and 94.37-94.38. Resistance was seen at 94.50-94.51.

"The short end is getting real quiet here as people bunker in for the mentality that the Fed is going to do nothing for a while," a Eurodollar trader said. The Federal Open Market Committee meets today and no change in monetary policy was expected, traders said.
"People really aren't seeing much reason to do anything in here," the trader added. "There just isn't any reason to get involved yet," he said.
More data is on tap for the rest of the week.
Thursday's October consumer price index is forecast up 0.3 percent overall and 0.2 percent excluding food and energy.
October retail sales, due on Thursday, are forecast up 0.3 percent overall and in the core rate.
At 0900 CST/1500 GMT, the Atlanta Fed's index will be released.
At 0749 CST/1349 GMT, Dec T-bonds were down 7/32 at 114-22/32, muni-bonds lost 11/32 to 116-26/32, March Eurodollars were flat at 94.46 and December Euros fell one basis point at 94.48.
